neighbours.label: digits of a unit-converted figure in parentheses after an area or distance (… 3,520 sq km (1,359 sq mi))
fire: The island has a total area of 3,520 sq km (1,359 sq mi) and a mild climate.
The forest reserve spans roughly 60 square kilometres (23 square miles) of hills.
Its main lake measures 812 km2 (314 sq mi) at high water.
The province covers 94,000 square kilometers (36,300 square miles) in total.
The reef stretches across about 2,300 km (1,430 mi) of coastline.
The national park protects 1,100 hectares (2,718 acres) of wetland.
Altogether the basin drains about 7,800 sq km (3,012 sq mi) of farmland.
The plateau sits at 2,400 metres (7,874 feet) above sea level.
